---
title: "References"
---

Primary sources cited across the workshop. Where a URL is not given, the item is
findable by title and author; nothing here is invented.

## Variational inference

- Blei, Kucukelbir and McAuliffe. "Variational Inference: A Review for Statisticians."
  *Journal of the American Statistical Association* 112(518), 2017.
- Wainwright and Jordan. "Graphical Models, Exponential Families, and Variational
  Inference." *Foundations and Trends in Machine Learning* 1(1–2), 2008.
- Hoffman, Blei, Wang and Paisley. "Stochastic Variational Inference." *JMLR* 14, 2013.
- Ranganath, Gerrish and Blei. "Black Box Variational Inference." *AISTATS*, 2014.
- Kucukelbir, Tran, Ranganath, Gelman and Blei. "Automatic Differentiation Variational
  Inference." *JMLR* 18, 2017.
- Kingma and Welling. "Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes." *ICLR*, 2014.
- Rezende, Mohamed and Wierstra. "Stochastic Backpropagation and Approximate Inference
  in Deep Generative Models." *ICML*, 2014.
- Mohamed, Rosca, Figurnov and Mnih. "Monte Carlo Gradient Estimation in Machine
  Learning." *JMLR* 21, 2020.
- Roeder, Wu and Duvenaud. "Sticking the Landing: Simple, Lower-Variance Gradient
  Estimators for Variational Inference." *NeurIPS*, 2017.
- Kingma and Ba. "Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization." *ICLR*, 2015.

## Markov chain Monte Carlo

- Betancourt. "A Conceptual Introduction to Hamiltonian Monte Carlo." arXiv:1701.02434, 2017.
- Neal. "MCMC Using Hamiltonian Dynamics." In *Handbook of Markov Chain Monte Carlo*,
  Chapman and Hall/CRC, 2011.
- Hoffman and Gelman. "The No-U-Turn Sampler: Adaptively Setting Path Lengths in
  Hamiltonian Monte Carlo." *JMLR* 15, 2014.
- Vehtari, Gelman, Simpson, Carpenter and Bürkner. "Rank-Normalization, Folding, and
  Localization: An Improved $\hat R$ for Assessing Convergence of MCMC." *Bayesian
  Analysis* 16(2), 2021.
- Geyer. "Practical Markov Chain Monte Carlo." *Statistical Science* 7(4), 1992.
- Betancourt and Girolami. "Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for Hierarchical Models."
  arXiv:1312.0906, 2013.
- Girolami and Calderhead. "Riemann Manifold Langevin and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
  Methods." *JRSS B* 73(2), 2011.
- Leimkuhler and Reich. *Simulating Hamiltonian Dynamics.* Cambridge University Press, 2004.
- Nesterov. "Primal-dual Subgradient Methods for Convex Problems." *Mathematical
  Programming* 120, 2009.
- Stan Development Team. *Stan Reference Manual*, chapter "MCMC Sampling".
